# montecarlo_presto_credentials (Resource)

Presto credentials are the login Monte Carlo stores for a Presto or Trino cluster. A Data Lake warehouse's query connection uses them. The password is never returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Hostname of the Presto or Trino coordinator.
- `port` (Number) Port the coordinator listens on.
- `user` (String) User Monte Carlo signs in as.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `catalog` (String) Catalog Monte Carlo queries.
- `http_scheme` (String) Whether to reach the coordinator over `http` or `https`.
- `metadata_catalog_id` (String) Name of the catalog in the metadata store, when it differs from `catalog`. Requires `catalog`, which may then hold only lowercase letters, digits, `_` and `-`.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password of `user`. Leave it out for a cluster that takes none. Stored by Monte Carlo and never returned.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send `password_wo` again. Terraform stores this, never the secret.
- `schema` (String) Schema Monte Carlo queries by default.
- `ssl_skip_verification` (Boolean) Connect over TLS without checking the server's certificate.

### Read-Only

- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
